title.zh: 找规律 · 不画也能报出第 100 个
title.en: Patterns · Name the 100th Without Drawing It

description.zh: 用火柴棒链数出前几项，求相邻总数的增量；增量不变时总数 = 增量×n + 起头。仅适用于相邻图形共用一条边的单排摆法。
description.en: Count the first few matchstick figures and find the step between totals; for a constant step, total = step × n + starter. Holds only for single chains whose neighbours share one side.

reason.zh: 每多一个图形总数增加同样的量，折线上的点排成直线，这个增量就是直线的斜率。
reason.en: Each extra shape adds the same number of sticks, so the points lie on a line and the step is that line's slope.

title.zh: 为什么数得出前几项就能写出第 n 项？
title.en: Why can counting a few terms give a rule for the nth?
